why: J1.2 is a named software application developed for teaching, practice, and examination of geographic object location on blind maps, rather than a general instructional element.
name: J1.2 interactive blind map teaching-examining e-learning system
product_description: A University of Debrecen-developed web-based e-learning application that lets geography students practise and take blind-map examinations while allowing teachers to configure exams and manage results.
